question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

A ______ mind rarely meets a dead end; it continues the search for the answers.
solution:
The correct answer is "**curious**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, The quality of the mind is expected to fill the blank.
 
• **The mind as described can never be put to rest because inquisitiveness **makes it to continue searching for the answers.
 
• Now, let us explore the meaning of the given options:
 
 
• **Peculiar means something strange, uncommon, **or unusual. (विचित्र)
 
 
• ***Example**: The milk probably has gone bad since it has a very **peculiar **smell.*
 
 
 
• **Weird means someone/ something strange** or unusual. (अजीब, विचित्र)
 
 
• ***Example**: I had a **weird **dream last night.*
 
 
 
• **Curious means a desire to investigate or learn something**. (जिज्ञासु)
 
 
• ***Example**: I am **curious** to know about the political shuffle happening in Maharashtra.*
 
 
 
• **Strange means something not familiar, different, **or difficult to understand. (अजीब)
 
 
• ***Example**: You are behaving in a **strange **way today.*
 
 
 
 
 
• From the meanings of the words **we can infer that "curious" **is the word that** matches the inquisitiveness(**जिज्ञासा**) of the mind in the given sentence**.
 
• Hence, the** correct answer is option (3) Curious.**

**Complete Sentence:**__

A ***__curious__*** mind rarely meets a dead end; it continues the search for the answers.
